nodes.label: Backup Procedure
nodes.rationale: mongodump of whole database including GridFS. Not point-in-time (standalone mongo has no oplog). Stop server first for clean backup, or accept small skew.

nodes.label: Restore Procedure
nodes.rationale: mongorestore with --drop. Never restore under a live server. Split-brain caveat: edits after backup point come back, deletions can be undone, sessions restore too.

nodes.label: Secret Rotation
nodes.rationale: Rotating SESSION_SECRET logs everyone out. If CONFIG_KEY is unset, also makes plugin secrets unreadable. Set CONFIG_KEY before first plugin secret to rotate independently.

nodes.label: Graceful Shutdown
nodes.rationale: SIGTERM: stop accepting connections, finish in-flight requests, flush dirty rooms, exit. Hard watchdog at SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECS (30s). Every deploy drops all connections.
